_meta.note: Assamese strings in this file were prepared for the prototype and MUST be reviewed by a native Assamese speaker (and an elder-care communication specialist) before any real deployment. Keys are isolated here so review is a single-file task. Any key missing from this file falls back to en.json at runtime.
